newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown in purchase talks with Hudson.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown in purchase talks with Hudson.

text.p: Melbourne casino operator Crown Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks with Hudson Conway Ltd about the purchase of shares in Crown Management Ltd.
Crown Management Pty Ltd is the operations manager of the company's Galleria Complex and soon-to-be opened Southbank Entertainment and casino complex.
Crown Ltd, which owns the casino building and licence, wants to buy the management contract from Crown Management Pty Ltd, which is currenlty wholly-owned by Hudson Conway.
Crown said the discussions had been initiated by its independent directors, who were seeking expert advice in relation to the proposed purchase.
Any agreement would be subject to shareholder approval.
Crown said it would also seek shareholder approval to bring forward the exercise date of an option held by Hudson Conway to acquire 74.5 million shares in Crown.
It was proposed to change the date from 1999-2001 to a 14-day period starting on the day shareholder approval was received, and to lower the exercise price to A$1.03 a share from A$1.15 a share.
The exercise of the option would increase Hudson Conway's holding in Crown to 40 percent from about 31 percent, a Crown spokesman said.
"The independent directors are pleased that Crown's largest shareholder Hudson Conway has further demonstrated its commitment to and confidence in the company," Crown said in a statement.
Crown directors believed the early exercise of the option would remove market uncertainty about the likelihood and timing of the option exercise and would increase capital and liquidity.
The reduction in the exercise price was in line with the earlier exercise period and the underlying value of the option, they said.
Hudson Conway said in a statement it had agreed to amend the terms of the option, and that a date for a meeting of Crown shareholders would be advised shortly.
Hudson Conway shares closed steady at A$16.50, while Crown shares ended eight cents lower at A$2.62.
